title: 0011-display-credential-logins-in-project-lists.md
body_text:
# ADR 0011: Display credential logins in authorized project lists

Date: 2026-07-12  
Status: accepted

## Context

ADR 0010 treated every credential value as a secret and required masked list projections. The approved table revision requires project members with category access to see login values directly, copy them quickly, and keep passwords protected behind explicit reveal and copy actions.

## Decision

Continue encrypting logins and passwords at rest. For an authorized credential-list request, the server decrypts and returns the login value but never returns the password. Password display and copy continue to use the dedicated authorized, rate-limited, `no-store` reveal endpoint.

The client provides compact accessible copy controls beside logins and show/hide and copy controls beside passwords. Revealed passwords remain only in ephemeral client state and are never persisted, logged, audited as values, sent to MCP, or included in list responses.

## Consequences

- Anyone authorized to list a category can read its login values without a second reveal action.
- Login values remain encrypted in PostgreSQL but are no longer classified as masked list secrets.
- Passwords retain the stricter explicit-reveal boundary from ADR 0010.
- List responses and browser memory now contain login plaintext and must not be cached, logged, indexed, or exposed through MCP.
